homonyms.basis: the MMRS record carries no disambiguation for this entity; the cards carry no homonym. The string pass found the acronym AIM in the archive only as Google AI Mode (#170, D0001–D0004), a collision on the acronym in the archive's own usage, set aside at reading (traversal reading.json). 'AI Incidents Monitor' is the entity's former name (F22), not a homonym. The neighbours (AI Incident Database, AIAAIC Repository), the operator's platform (the OECD.AI Policy Observatory), its data supplier (Event Registry), its supporter (the Patrick J. McGovern Foundation), the common reporting framework and the Tow Center study it holds are distinct entities, kept as relations, never senses of the name.

captures.description: THE OECD AIM, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a real-time tracking tool developed by the OECD.AI Policy Observatory in collaboration with the Patrick J. McGovern Foundation'; it aggregates world news through Event Registry, 'processing over 150,000 news articles daily'; 14 risk themes; the definitions of incident and hazard. Six cards, five the OECD's own (the monitor, the methodology page, the May 2024 definitions report).
